mapper.select: select setting.sys_id, setting.call_cd, setting.call_nm, setting.single_yn, setting.description from consumer_staff_call_setting setting where setting.sys_plant_cd = #{sysPlantCd} order by setting.insert_datetime asc, setting.sys_id asc
mapper.insert: insert into consumer_staff_call_master ( sys_id, sys_plant_cd, table_sys_id, table_num, consumer_session_id, read_yn, insert_datetime ) values ( #{sysId}, #{sysPlantCd}, #{tableSysId}, #{tableNum}, #{consumerSessionId}, 'N', now() )
insert into consumer_staff_call ( sys_id, link_sys_id, call_cd, description, quantity ) values ( #{sysId}, #{linkSysId}, #{callCd}, #{description}, #{quantity} )
